summary: Belize's Immigration Department lists US, UK, Canadian, Australian, CARICOM and many EU passports as not needing a visa; it says a stay longer than 30 days must be extended at an Immigration Office with a Visitor's Permit Extension, which costs BZD 200. Nationalities that need a visa apply for a consular visa — though holders of a valid multiple-entry US, Canadian or Schengen visa, or of a US or Canadian permanent residence card, are exempt for visits of up to 30 days.

conditionalWaivers.text: Travelers whose nationality would normally need a Belizean visa are exempt for visits of up to 30 days if they hold a valid multiple-entry US visa or a US permanent residence card. The same exemption covers a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa, and a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa or Canadian permanent residence card.

source.name: Belize Immigration Department — Do you need a visa to travel to Belize?

fee.notes: Single-entry visa, valid 6 months: BZD 200 for most nationalities, BZD 750 for nationals of India, Nepal, Thailand, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Pakistan and Sri Lanka, and BZD 3,000 for nationals of the People's Republic of China. A multiple-entry visa, valid 12 months, costs BZD 300, 1,000 or 4,000 respectively.

source.name: Belize Immigration Department — Visa Fees

Belize Immigration Department — Visitor's Permit Extension

validityDays.text: Single entry visas are valid for 6 months.

entries.text: Single entry visas are valid for 6 months.

stayDays.text: A visa allows you to enter Belize and remain legal in Belize for a maximum of 30 days from date of entry.

extendable.text: The Visitor’s Permit Extension allows you to stay in Belize for an additional 30 days. Fees Fees with effect from 1 May 2020. All fees are in Belize dollars. The Visitor’s Permit Extension fee is BZ$200.00 for all nationals. Who can Qualify Persons who want to extend their holidays in Belize or persons investigating the possibilities of settlement. Persons who require a visa (see Visa Section) after a predefined number of extended days in Belize, must acquire that visa before being issued a visitor’s permit extension. Holders of a Belize visa may qualify for visitor’s permit extension.

fee.notes: BZD 200 for each 30-day Visitor's Permit Extension, the same for all nationalities. The extension does not allow employment or business without the Director of Immigration's consent.

source.name: Belize Immigration Department — Visitor's Permit

fee.text: The Visitor’s Permit Extension fee is BZ$200.00 for all nationals.

stayDays.text: The Visitor’s Permit Extension allows you to stay in Belize for an additional 30 days.

passportValidity.text: Belize's Immigration Department asks visa applicants for a passport valid for more than 6 months, and publishes no minimum for visa-exempt visitors. The UK Foreign Office tells British nationals their passport must expire more than 3 months after the date they arrive, and that some airlines may refuse boarding if it does not run more than 6 months beyond arrival.

source.name: Belize Immigration Department — Visa Requirements

conflict.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Belize entry requirements
conflict.states: Passport must have an expiry date more than 3 months after the date you arrive

travelInsurance.text: No official source we could read states a travel-insurance requirement for Belize. The Government Press Office's Cabinet brief of 14 July 2022 records Cabinet's approval of the removal of all public-health measures at points of entry.

source.name: Government of Belize Press Office — Cabinet Brief, 14 July 2022 (removal of all public-health measures at points of entry)
source.instrument: Statutory Instrument No. 100 of 2022, Public Health (Reform) (Prevention of the Spread of Infectious Disease) (COVID-19) Regulations, 2022 — in force 12 July 2022, repealing S.I. 61 of 2022; contains no entry or insurance requirement

onwardTicket.text: Visa applicants must submit a flight itinerary showing arrival in Belize and the return date to their country of origin (or onward departure if transiting). Canada's travel advice says customs officials may ask visitors for a return or onward ticket.

source.name: Belize Immigration and Nationality Department — Visa requirements (documents)

proofOfFunds.text: Visa applicants must provide an employment letter and banking financials (their sponsor's too, if sponsored). Canada's travel advice says customs officials may ask visitors for proof of sufficient funds to cover their stay. No amount is published.

source.name: Belize Immigration and Nationality Department — Visa requirements (documents)

currencyLimits.text: The US State Department gives USD 5,000 as Belize's currency restriction on entry and on exit, without saying whether larger sums must be declared or are barred. No Belizean source we could read states the rule; items that must be declared are listed on the immigration and customs declaration form.

source.name: U.S. Department of State — Belize country information

notes: The Government of Canada notes that a permit is required to collect, possess or export certain plants, animals and plant and animal products (Belize is a party to CITES), that damaging the coral reef is a criminal offence, and that possessing pre-Columbian or Colonial-period artifacts requires a permit.
Firearms and ammunition are strictly regulated; the Government of Canada warns of heavy fines and jail time for possessing an unlicensed firearm or ammunition.

safety.text: The UK Foreign Office says Belize has one of the highest per capita murder rates in the world, with serious gang-related violence most frequent in Belize City south of the Haulover Creek (Southside); tourists are not normally the targets but anyone nearby could be affected. It says tourists are vulnerable to theft, including in San Pedro, Caye Caulker, Placencia and San Ignacio. Canada advises against non-essential travel to Southside Belize City.

bestTimeToVisit.text: The Government of Canada says the rainy season runs from May to November and the Atlantic hurricane season from early June to the end of November; seasonal flooding can make roads impassable. Bush and forest fires are common between December and May, particularly in the Cayo District and the southern districts.

tips.text: If your nationality needs a Belizean visa but you hold a valid multiple-entry US, Canadian or Schengen visa (or a US or Canadian permanent residence card), the Immigration Department exempts you from the visa for visits of up to 30 days.

According to the UK Foreign Office, leaving Belize by land, or by water to Guatemala or Mexico, means paying a departure tax of BZD 40 or USD 20 at the border. When leaving by air, the tax is usually included in the airfare.
Belize's Immigration Department says a stay longer than 30 days needs a Visitor's Permit Extension from an Immigration Office; each extension allows an additional 30 days and costs BZD 200.
The Government of Canada advises against non-essential travel to Southside Belize City, south of the Haulover Creek River, because of gang and drug-related violence, including murders and shootings.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Belize?
faq.answer: Belize's Immigration Department lists US, UK, Canadian, Australian, New Zealand, CARICOM and many EU passports as not needing a visa. Nationalities that do need a visa apply at a Belizean consulate, or are exempt for visits of up to 30 days if they hold a valid multiple-entry US, Canadian or Schengen visa, or a US or Canadian permanent residence card.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Belize?
faq.answer: Belize's Immigration Department says that if you will stay longer than 30 days you must visit an Immigration Office to extend your stay with a Visitor's Permit Extension. Each extension allows an additional 30 days and costs BZD 200.

faq.question: Can I enter Belize with a US visa instead of a Belizean visa?
faq.answer: Yes. Belize's Immigration Department exempts from its visa requirement, for visits of up to 30 days, travellers holding a valid multiple-entry US visa or a US permanent residence card. A valid multiple-entry Canadian or Schengen visa, or a Canadian permanent residence card, qualifies too.

faq.question: Is travel insurance mandatory for Belize?
faq.answer: No official source we could read requires it. The Government Press Office's Cabinet brief of 14 July 2022 records Cabinet's approval of the removal of all public-health measures at points of entry.

faq.question: Can I pay with US dollars in Belize?
faq.answer: The Government of Canada says US dollars are widely accepted and prices are sometimes given in US dollars, but change for US-dollar payments is frequently given in Belize dollars.
